title: Enterprise Connectivity: posted net evidence
content:
## Application
Enterprise Connectivity applies this posted net evidence rule to separate statutory tax.

## Basis: posted
For separate statutory tax, sum net service subtotal only from posted service charge records with source classification primary, selected pricing branch portfolio, meter type internet outbound transfer, source-event reference equal to selected export bundle and period equal to source billing month; only this exact completed net invoice enters the tax base.
